articles.summary: CONWAY, Ark., Nov. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Home BancShares, Inc. (NYSE: HOMB) (“Home” or “the Company”), and its wholly-owned subsidiary, Centennial Bank (“Centennial”), announced that it will participate in a Fireside Chat during the Stephens Annual Investment Conference being held November 17, 2026. The Company will present at 10:15 a.m. CT (11:15 a.m. ET), on Tuesday, November 17, 2026. The Fireside Chat can be accessed live using the following link: https://event.summitcast.com/view/AnJcL7fjsXraGqV8XG6fRL/3SEU7Swd59NJBiRCUnBRYe . A replay will be available from the webcast link for 90 days following the live presentation. Home BancShares, Inc. is a bank holding company, headquartered in Conway, Arkansas. Its wholly-owned subsidiary, Centennial Bank, provides a broad range of commercial and retail banking plus related financial services to businesses, real estate developers, investors, individuals and municipalities.
